grammar.summary: 本课学习表记录的 instrument 语义与 so arranged that 结果从句。

points.title: so arranged that 表如此安排
points.explanation: The pens are so arranged that they record... so + 过去分词 + that：方式副词引发结果从句。

examples.en: The instruments are so designed that they move with the earth.
examples.cn: 仪器设计得能随地球移动。

points.title: 表"同时"的 the moment (that) 复现
points.explanation: The moment the earthquake starts, ... = 一……就复现。

examples.en: The machine starts writing the moment the ground moves.
examples.cn: 地面一动，机器就开始记录。
